name: io.github.sepehr071/jobvision-mcp
title: Jobvision Jobs
description: Read-only Jobvision (jobvision.ir) Iran jobs: search ads, job and company details, advertised pay.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVISION_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Jobvision requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
